[SWS_UCM_00243] Too big block size received by UCM
⌈
In the case the received
block size with
TransferData
exceeds the block size returned by
TransferStart
for the same TransferId,
UCM
shall raise the
ApplicationError IncorrectBlock-
Size
.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00014, RS_UCM_00025)
